svg.title: Three points on the Klein quartic have one image on its elliptic quotient
svg.desc: The Klein quartic and its elliptic quotient. The three marked points have coordinates (1,0,0), (0,1,0), and (0,0,1) in the chart X+Y+Z=1. The map sends each to (u,W)=(0,1).
svg.text: The rings mark one exact fibre.
